newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech c.bank sets 13-week T-bills at 12.4 percent.
newsitem.headline: Czech c.bank sets 13-week T-bills at 12.4 percent.

text.p: The Czech National Bank on Wednesday set a Dutch auction offering five billion crowns in 13-week Finance Ministry treasury bills for Thursday, with maximum gross yield on bids set at 12.4 percent.
The last auction offering five billion crowns in 13-week treasury bills on January 16, averaged 11.9 percent and the auction was heavily oversubscribed with bids totalling 19.894 billion crowns.
